description: This file defines a test case class `BeanFactoryTestCase` used for testing bean factory functions within the SuiteCRM project. It includes setup and teardown methods, module configuration providers, and methods for managing module extensions and file inclusion. The class is part of the namespace `SuiteCRM[Test` and extends `SuitePHPUnitFrameworkTestCase`, indicating it uses PHPUnit framework for testing.

classes.name: BeanFactoryTestCase
classes.description: A PHPUnit test case class for testing bean factory operations within SuiteCRM. It provides methods for module management, extension handling, and configuration setup.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes the test case, removing core modules extensions before calling parent setup.

methods.name: tearDown
methods.description: Cleans up after tests by removing extensions and refreshing module globals.

methods.name: moduleConfigProvider
methods.description: Provides configuration data for modules, including class names, files, and customizations.

methods.name: getModuleList
methods.description: Returns a list of modules to test, either all or a single specified module.

methods.name: shouldSkipModule
methods.description: Determines if a module should be skipped based on its class file and properties.

methods.name: compileIncludeExtFiles
methods.description: Compiles extension files into a single include file for performance.

methods.name: shouldSkipFileEntry
methods.description: Checks if a file in extension directory should be skipped based on filename and existence.

methods.name: addCoreModuleExtension
methods.description: Adds an extension for a specific module by creating relevant PHP files.

methods.name: removeCoreModuleExtension
methods.description: Removes extension files for a specific module.

methods.name: removeCoreModuleAllExtension
methods.description: Removes all extension files for all modules.

methods.name: refreshModuleGlobals
methods.description: Reloads global variables related to module configurations from 'include/modules.php'.
